name: RPM
description: Rotations per minute: how fast a part spins.

pages.title: RPM
pages.text:
**RPM** (rotations per minute) is how fast a part spins. A network shares one speed, scaled by gear ratios: large to small cogwheel doubles it.\
\
Some machines need a minimum, like 32 RPM for an Alternator. Faster also costs more stress. A Speedometer shows speed; goggles give the exact RPM.
